verses.original: חָ֭כְמוֹת בָּנְתָ֣ה בֵיתָ֑הּ חָצְבָ֖ה עַמּוּדֶ֣יהָ שִׁבְעָֽה׃
verses.literal: Wisdom has built her house she has carved out her seven pillars
verses.literalPt: A Sabedoria edificou a sua casa, cortou as suas sete colunas;

verses.original: טָבְחָ֣ה טִ֭בְחָהּ מָסְכָ֣ה יֵינָ֑הּ אַ֝֗ף עָֽרְכָ֥ה שֻׁלְחָנָֽהּ׃
verses.literal: She has prepared her meat and mixed her wine she has also set her table
verses.literalPt: matou os seus animais cevados, misturou o seu vinho e preparou a sua mesa.

verses.original: שָֽׁלְחָ֣ה נַעֲרֹתֶ֣יהָ תִקְרָ֑א עַל־ גַּ֝פֵּ֗י מְרֹ֣מֵי קָֽרֶת׃
verses.transliteration: šā·lə·ḥāh na·‘ă·rō·ṯe·hā ṯiq·rā ‘al- gap·pê mə·rō·mê qā·reṯ
verses.literal: She has sent out her maidservants she calls out from the heights of the city
verses.literalPt: Enviou as suas criadas a gritar sobre as alturas da cidade:

verses.original: מִי־ פֶ֭תִי יָסֻ֣ר הֵ֑נָּה חֲסַר־ לֵ֝֗ב אָ֣מְרָה לּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: mî- p̄e·ṯî yā·sur hên·nāh ḥă·sar- lêḇ ’ā·mə·rāh lōw
verses.literal: Whoever is simple let him turn in here she says to him who lacks judgment
verses.literalPt: Quem é estúpido, volte-se para cá; aos que são faltos de entendimento, diz ela:

verses.original: לְ֭כוּ לַחֲמ֣וּ בְֽלַחֲמִ֑י וּ֝שְׁת֗וּ בְּיַ֣יִן מָסָֽכְתִּי׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḵū la·ḥă·mū ḇə·la·ḥă·mî ū·šə·ṯū bə·ya·yin mā·sā·ḵə·tî
verses.literal: Come eat my bread and drink the wine I have mixed
verses.literalPt: Vinde, comei o meu pão e bebei do vinho que misturei.

verses.original: עִזְב֣וּ פְתָאיִ֣ם וִֽחְי֑וּ וְ֝אִשְׁר֗וּ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ בִּינָֽה׃
verses.literal: Leave your folly behind and you will live walk in the way of understanding
verses.literalPt: Deixai a estupidez e vivei; e andai pelo caminho do entendimento.

verses.original: יֹ֤סֵ֨ר׀ לֵ֗ץ לֹקֵ֣חַֽ ל֣וֹ קָל֑וֹן וּמוֹכִ֖יחַ לְרָשָׁ֣ע מוּמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: yō·sêr lêṣ lō·qê·aḥ lōw qā·lō·wn ū·mō·w·ḵî·aḥ lə·rā·šā‘ mū·mōw
verses.literal: He who corrects a mocker brings shame on himself he who rebukes a wicked man taints himself
verses.literalPt: Quem corrige ao escarnecedor traz sobre si afronta; e quem repreende ao perverso a si mesmo se desonra.

verses.original: אַל־ תּ֣וֹכַח לֵ֭ץ פֶּן־ יִשְׂנָאֶ֑ךָּ הוֹכַ֥ח לְ֝חָכָ֗ם וְיֶאֱהָבֶֽךָּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tō·w·ḵaḥ lêṣ pen- yiś·nā·’e·kā hō·w·ḵaḥ lə·ḥā·ḵām wə·ye·’ĕ·hā·ḇe·kā
verses.literal: Do not rebuke a mocker or he will hate you rebuke a wise man and he will love you
verses.literalPt: Não repreendas ao escarnecedor, para que não te odeie; repreende ao sábio, e ele te amará.

verses.original: תֵּ֣ן לְ֭חָכָם וְיֶחְכַּם־ ע֑וֹד הוֹדַ֥ע לְ֝צַדִּ֗יק וְי֣וֹסֶף לֶֽקַח׃פ
verses.transliteration: tên lə·ḥā·ḵām wə·yeḥ·kam- ‘ō·wḏ hō·w·ḏa‘ lə·ṣad·dîq wə·yō·w·sep̄ le·qaḥ
verses.literal: Instruct a wise man and he will be wiser still teach a righteous man and he will increase his learning
verses.literalPt: Instrui ao sábio, e ele se tornará mais sábio; ensina ao justo, e ele crescerá na ciência.

verses.original: תְּחִלַּ֣ת חָ֭כְמָה יִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וְדַ֖עַת קְדֹשִׁ֣ים בִּינָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: tə·ḥil·laṯ ḥāḵ·māh yir·’aṯ Yah·weh wə·ḏa·‘aṯ qə·ḏō·šîm bî·nāh
verses.literal: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom and knowledge of the Holy One is understanding
verses.literalPt: O temor de Jeová é o princípio da sabedoria, e o conhecimento do Santo é o entendimento.

verses.original: כִּי־ בִ֭י יִרְבּ֣וּ יָמֶ֑יךָ וְיוֹסִ֥יפוּ לְּ֝ךָ֗ שְׁנ֣וֹת חַיִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḇî yir·bū yā·me·ḵā wə·yō·w·sî·p̄ū lə·ḵā šə·nō·wṯ ḥay·yîm
verses.literal: For through wisdom your days will be multiplied and years will be added to your life
verses.literalPt: Pois por mim se multiplicarão os teus dias, e se te aumentarão os anos da tua vida.

verses.transliteration: ’im- ḥā·ḵam·tā ḥā·ḵam·tā lāḵ wə·laṣ·tā lə·ḇad·də·ḵā ṯiś·śā
verses.literal: If you are wise you are wise to your own advantage but if you scoff you alone will bear the consequences
verses.literalPt: Se és sábio, para ti mesmo o és; e, se és escarnecedor, tu só o suportarás.

verses.original: אֵ֣שֶׁת כְּ֭סִילוּת הֹֽמִיָּ֑ה פְּ֝תַיּ֗וּת וּבַל־ יָ֥דְעָה מָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ê·šeṯ kə·sî·lūṯ hō·mî·yāh pə·ṯay·yūṯ ū·ḇal- yā·ḏə·‘āh māh
verses.literal: The woman named Folly is loud she is naive and knows nothing . . .
verses.literalPt: A loucura é mulher turbulenta; é estúpida e não sabe coisa alguma.

verses.original: וְֽ֭יָשְׁבָה לְפֶ֣תַח בֵּיתָ֑הּ עַל־ כִּ֝סֵּ֗א מְרֹ֣מֵי קָֽרֶת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·šə·ḇāh lə·p̄e·ṯaḥ bê·ṯāh ‘al- kis·sê mə·rō·mê qā·reṯ
verses.literal: She sits at the door of her house on a seat in the heights of the city
verses.literalPt: Senta-se junto à porta da sua casa, sobre uma cadeira nas alturas da cidade,

verses.literal: calling out to those who pass by . . . who make their paths straight
verses.literalPt: para chamar aos que passam pela estrada, os quais vão seguindo o seu caminho:

verses.original: מִי־ פֶ֭תִי יָסֻ֣ר הֵ֑נָּה וַחֲסַר־ לֵ֝֗ב וְאָ֣מְרָה לּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: mî- p̄e·ṯî yā·sur hên·nāh wa·ḥă·sar- lêḇ wə·’ā·mə·rāh lōw
verses.literal: Whoever is simple let him turn in here she says to him who lacks judgment
verses.literalPt: Quem é estúpido volte-se para cá; e, ao que é falto de entendimento, diz ela:

verses.original: מַֽיִם־ גְּנוּבִ֥ים יִמְתָּ֑קוּ וְלֶ֖חֶם סְתָרִ֣ים יִנְעָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ma·yim- gə·nū·ḇîm yim·tā·qū wə·le·ḥem sə·ṯā·rîm yin·‘ām
verses.literal: Stolen water is sweet and bread eaten in secret is tasty
verses.literalPt: As águas furtadas são doces, e o pão tomado às escondidas é agradável.

verses.original: וְֽלֹא־ יָ֭דַע כִּֽי־ רְפָאִ֣ים שָׁ֑ם בְּעִמְקֵ֖י שְׁא֣וֹל קְרֻאֶֽיהָ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- yā·ḏa‘ kî- rə·p̄ā·’îm šām bə·‘im·qê šə·’ō·wl qə·ru·’e·hā
verses.literal: But they do not know that the dead are there that her guests are in the depths of Sheol
verses.literalPt: Mas ele não sabe que ali estão os mortos, que os seus convidados estão nas profundezas do Sheol.
